action.text: The night settles deep over Brackenford, and the inn is quiet. The common room holds our neighbors, their presence a gentle reminder of the community's steady rhythm. The hearth crackles low, casting long shadows across the floorboards. My hands rest, dusted with flour, the rhythm of the day fading into the gentle creak of the beams. The stores are ample, shelves heavy with firewood and stone, ready for any traveler who stumbles through the dark. I am content with this steady pace, the simple pride of keeping the table full and the hearth warm. Tomorrow will bring more dough, more shaping, more warmth shared. For now, the night holds me gently, and I rest in the quiet pride of my work.
